text:
sam: Quick ask — can someone run a throughput baseline for the queue-handoff change? Planning to reduce the batching window from 12ms -> 8ms and enable handoff when queue depth > 4. Need p50/p95 tokens/sec, average batch tokens, and GPU mem on rtx-a100-40. Single steady 5m run is fine. Thx
lia: I can do this in ~30m. Which model and seq settings?
mike: Note: the handoff flag is in PR #642 on the handoff-experiment branch (not merged). If you run before merge use branch name.
sam: Use model gptx-7b, max_seq 2048, avg_seq ~128. Script: bench/continuous_handoff.py. Ramp 30s, steady 300s.
lia: Got it. Command?
sam: ```
python bench/continuous_handoff.py --model gptx-7b --max-seq 2048 --avg-seq 128 --ramp 30 --steady 300 --handoff-window-ms 8 --handoff-depth 4
```
deploy-bot: scheduled run r-20240512-57 on dev-gpu-03 (queue pos 2) :white_check_mark:
julia: Started run on dev-gpu-03 (handoff branch). Will post metrics when steady.
bench-bot: run r-20240512-57 reached steady-state (300s) — collecting artifacts.
julia: Results (initial):
```
run: r-20240512-57
model: gptx-7b
config: window=8ms, handoff_depth=4
p50_tokens/s: 42000
p95_tokens/s: 38000
avg_batch_tokens: 4600
gpu_mem_gb: 22.1
observations: small tail latency spikes (~120ms) when queue depth oscillates between 3-5
```
lia: Hm. Can you also capture KV cache stats and the per-request batch-size histogram? Add --kv-stats and --hist to the next run.
julia: Will do. Starting run with --kv-stats --hist and handoff-depth 3, window 6ms.
bench-bot: scheduled run r-20240512-58 on dev-gpu-03 (handoff branch)
julia: Run r-20240512-58 completed. Summary:
```
run: r-20240512-58
config: window=6ms, handoff_depth=3
p50_tokens/s: 45000
p95_tokens/s: 40000
avg_batch_tokens: 5200
gpu_mem_gb: 23.0
kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.87
batch_size_hist: 1: 10%, 2: 25%, 3: 30%, 4: 20%, 5+: 15%
notes: tail spikes gone, latency stable
```
mike: Nice. Can you upload the raw CSV + flamegraphs to the bench bucket and paste link? I'll open a short PR with graphs.
julia: Uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/handoff/r-20240512-58/{metrics.csv,flame.svg} — adding to PR.
mike: I'll put together a brief writeup and tag eng-runtime for a quick review. On the PR I'll include recommended default: window=6ms, handoff_depth=3 as an opt-in flag for 7b models.
lia: Small ask: add a note about memory regression for 7b in the changelog if we flip default. +1 to include a safeguard env var to cap memory.
sam: Great work — please paste the PR link here and add a short table with p50/p95 comparison. After review we'll schedule a canary on dedicated. :thumbsup:
julia: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/706 — includes CSVs and plots. Added quick table in the PR description.
mike: sg, I'll review this afternoon. Thanks everyone.
sam: TY!"
